annotations.title: Ontario guard and railing code checker

description: Whether a guard is required, its minimum height, opening limit, climbing rule and design loads under the Ontario Building Code Part 9 and Part 3 for a described situation.

drop.description: Drop to the adjacent surface within 1.2 m (4 ft). A guard is required above 600 mm (23.6 in).

location.description: dwelling = within a dwelling unit; exthouse = exterior serving one dwelling unit; part9 = other Part 9 building; exit3 = required exit in a larger (Part 3) building.

opening.description: Largest opening: the widest sphere that passes through the guard.

stair_triangle.description: Optional stair triangle gap, widest sphere.

use.description: normal = ordinary guard; equip = access way to an equipment platform where many people are improbable.

name: guard_and_railing_code_checker_ontario
